risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: Exposure to regulatory changes affecting utility operations, rate reviews, and cost recovery mechanisms across eight-state footprint
risks.score_rationale: Company operates under strict federal and state regulatory frameworks; unfavorable regulatory decisions could materially impact financial results and capital recovery mechanisms (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.summary: Energy infrastructure increasingly targeted by cyber threats; operational disruptions could impact customer service and financial performance
risks.score_rationale: Critical infrastructure operator vulnerable to cyber attacks that could disrupt operations, compromise customer data, and damage reputation (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Environmental and Wildfire Risk
risks.summary: Established Emergency PSPS program and Wildfire Mitigation Plan; Wyoming HB0192 provides liability protections for compliant utilities; ongoing regulatory scrutiny and capital requirements
risks.score_rationale: Western utility operations exposed to increasing wildfire risks requiring significant mitigation investments; regulatory and liability exposure if mitigation inadequate (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Merger Integration Risk
risks.summary: Proposed merger awaiting FERC, MPSC, NPSC, SDPUC approvals and HSR clearance; combined entity will serve 0.7M electric and 1.5M gas customers across eight states
risks.score_rationale: Pending all-stock merger with NorthWestern expected to close H2 2026 subject to multiple regulatory approvals; integration complexity and execution risks (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Labor and Supply Chain Risk
risks.summary: Significant five-year capital investment program dependent on construction personnel availability and material supply chain resilience
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on qualified workforce and suppliers for capital investment programs; labor availability and commodity price volatility could impact project execution (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate and Credit Risk
risks.summary: Higher interest rates impacting long-term debt and commercial paper borrowing costs; dependent on market access for infrastructure financing
risks.score_rationale: Utility capital-intensive business requires access to credit markets; rising interest rates increase debt service costs as evidenced by 18.4M$ increase in 2025 (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Weather and Commodity Price Risk
risks.summary: Favorable weather in 2025 benefited Gas Utilities; unfavorable weather impacts Electric Utilities; fuel and purchased power costs subject to volatility
risks.score_rationale: Operating results affected by weather patterns and energy commodity prices; although regulatory mechanisms provide partial offset (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.summary: Community-focused utility with 142-year operating history; reputation dependent on operational excellence and customer service delivery
risks.score_rationale: Public utility company subject to community expectations regarding service reliability, environmental stewardship, and customer rates (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Black Hills Corporation has limited explicit AI mentions in its 10-K but demonstrates indirect engagement through data center infrastructure expansion. Wyoming Electric provides power to major AI data center customers Meta and Microsoft under its LPCS Tariff, reflecting emerging opportunities in the AI infrastructure sector rather than corporate AI adoption.
evidence: Wyoming Electric partnership with Meta for AI data center power provision, announced July 2024, transitioning to permanent service Q1 2026
Active negotiations with prospective new data center customers for AI infrastructure support
Multiple system peak demand records in 2025 driven by large-load data center customers
